helper_terms: cards=>{const ds=load("term_definitions");for(const c of cards){for(const [term,cn,en,src] of ds){const esc=term.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,"\\$&");const pat=term==="NAD"||term==="NADP"?esc+"\\+?":esc;const re=new RegExp("(?<![A-Za-z0-9])"+pat+"(?![A-Za-z0-9₂])");const ai=c.answer.findIndex(a=>re.test(a.text));if(ai<0)continue;if(c.answer.some(a=>a.text.includes(en)))continue;c.answer[ai].text=c.answer[ai].text.replace(re,match=>match+"（"+cn+"，"+en+"）");if(!c.source_units.includes(src))c.source_units.push(src);c.terminology_sources??=[];if(!c.terminology_sources.some(t=>t.term===term))c.terminology_sources.push({term,chinese:cn,english:en,source_unit:src});}for(const a of c.answer){a.text=a.text.replace(/NAD（([^）]+)）\+/g,"NAD+（$1）").replace(/NADP（([^）]+)）\+/g,"NADP+（$1）").replace(/乙酰CoA（辅酶A，coenzyme A）/g,"乙酰CoA（乙酰辅酶A，acetyl CoA；CoA为coenzyme A）").replace(/乙酰 CoA（辅酶A，coenzyme A）/g,"乙酰 CoA（乙酰辅酶A，acetyl CoA；CoA为coenzyme A）");}}return cards;}
